stop_claims.stop_reason: No exercise contrast in the sequenced samples. GSE185154 contains only genotype (Cdk4 WT/RR/KO, MLC-Cre, E2F3 mKO) x muscle (QA, soleus) groups with n = 3, all without an exercise intervention; the paper's exercise data (S2.5.p1, FIG4A-C, Supplemental Figure 11) are qPCR/western, not RNA-seq. The genotype contrasts the paper did sequence do not answer how exercise affects gene expression, and no column of the metadata defines exercise.
